subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which fix path should own trusted `read` image results that contain image blocks but no `details.path` before Feishu and other channel delivery?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the available fix paths differ on whether to re-use raw local tool args or save image bytes into controlled media storage, and that choice intersects with Feishu local-reference exposure risk.

options.title: Use media-store promotion
options.body: Land or repair the approach that saves pathless `read` image blocks into `media://inbound/...` and queues that safe reference for outbound delivery.

options.title: Constrain start-arg fallback
options.body: Permit `path` or `file_path` fallback only with explicit trusted-root checks and failure behavior that does not expose raw local references.

options.title: Pause for live proof first
options.body: Keep the issue and candidates open until one path provides redacted Feishu read-image delivery proof and addresses the local-reference exposure concern.

recommendation.title: Use media-store promotion
recommendation.body: Land or repair the approach that saves pathless `read` image blocks into `media://inbound/...` and queues that safe reference for outbound delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame places the active extractor and queueing surfaces in this area under their recent merged work.
